newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BTPs seek prop at 133.17 as downside tugs.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BTPs seek prop at 133.17 as downside tugs.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will look for a foothold at 133.17 on Friday in a correction that could take them as far as 132.64 short-term, analysts said.
"They're going down," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.

He said initial support would arrive at recent lows on the way up during the contract's scorching rally from June 10. The first stop comes in at 133.17 from the June 24 low. Below there, the 132.55 low on June 19 would lend a hand.
BTPs were quoted at 134.04 at 0805 GMT, down 25 basis points from Thursday's pit settlement.
The main downside target however was 132.64, a 38 percent retracement of rally up from the low of 129.07 on June 10 to the 134.84 high on June 26.
"Daily studies are overbought and have turned lower and we are looking for a short-term correction back to 132.64," Wilkin said.
Technical analysts at an Italian bank in London noted the contract hit a new high on Thursday at 134.84 but closed below the previous settlement.
"The contract breached the 134.00 threshold and bounced back on the support trendline," they said in a research note.
"Opening below this (today at 134.40) should imply further retracement with probable testing of 133.70-133.40 levels," they said.

Wilkin said resistance this session would come from the 134.84 high. The contract may retest that high this session but it was unlikely to give way and sideways consolidation was more likely, he said.
September Eurolire were quoted at 93.43, down four basis points on the day.
